transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to convene a batch-disposition huddle for Batch H-418. As you know, a cure-temperature alarm appeared during the Tuesday night run on Press 8, and per our standard procedure, I need a laboratory report and a pallet-level traceability check before I can make my final disposition decision. The housings are currently staged on pallets P1 through P4 and have not been shipped. Can I get the lab and traceability teams to report in?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed a differential-scanning-calorimetry review of retained samples from Batch H-418 after the cure-temperature alarm. The DSC review confirmed that exactly 240 housings from Batch H-418 are undercured. These 240 housings require a 4-hour thermal rework, and all 240 reworked housings will require a hardness test before release. I should note that my lab report is still awaiting final upload to the quality system, so it is not yet officially in the system.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I performed the pallet-level serial lookup after the alarm and confirmed that the 240 affected housings are exactly the 120 units on P2 and the 120 units on P3. P1 and P4 contain the 760 unaffected housings. I have not yet attached the lookup to the batch record because the disposition huddle has not been completed.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.disposition: Conditional release: 760 unaffected housings on P1 and P4 cleared for shipment; 240 undercured housings on P2 and P3 require 4-hour thermal rework followed by hardness testing before release.
decisions.shipment_release_plan: P1 and P4 (760 unaffected housings) released for shipment immediately. P2 and P3 (240 affected housings) held pending 4-hour thermal rework and hardness testing. All 240 reworked housings must pass hardness test before release.

commitments.detail: Ravi to complete final upload of DSC lab report to the quality system as soon as possible.
Marta to attach pallet-level serial lookup to the batch record once this disposition huddle is formally concluded.
All 240 thermally reworked housings must undergo and pass hardness testing before release from P2 and P3.
